title: [Master Data Management] Disable cross-env setup action OnPrem and fix field visibility issues
summary: Master Data Management cross-environment setup action is now disabled for on-premises installations and field visibility is corrected to display cross-environment details properly on the setup page.
key_points: Cross-environment setup action disabled for on-premises deployments
Cross-environment details now display correctly on the setup page instead of showing empty source company
Feature remains functional only in Business Central Online
Tests added to validate the new behavior
Low-risk change for the new master data synchronization feature
quote: Since the feature works only in Business Central Online, disable the cross-environment setup action OnPrem.
